title: Phase evolution regulation of CZTSSe absorbers via a ZnO blocking layer enables 14.45% efficient kesterite solar cells with low VOC deficit
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,8366-8381
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02706C, Paper
JinJin Chi, Hao Wei, Liangli Chu, Litao Han, Tong Liu, Xinyi Zhong, Dongxing Kou, Wenhui Zhou, Zhengji Zhou, Shengjie Yuan, Yuena Meng, Yafang Qi, Zhipeng Shao, Guanglei Cui, Sixin Wu
The one-step phase evolution from CZTS to CZTSSe was realized through a ZnO blocking layer. This prevented the formation of detrimental secondary phases, resulting in an absorber with superior crystalline quality and reduced defect concentration.
